verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports Slack integration that 'replies when the agent finishes' and webhook-triggered automations, giving developers completion notifications outside the CLI (openhands-docs-11, openhands-docs-37, openhands-gh-4). It also has a separate question-handling flow so agent questions don't block the main conversation (openhands-docs-18), and CLI 'Esc' can pause a running agent (openhands-docs-17), suggesting some in-session interruption handling. However, there's no dedicated 'needs my input' push notification (e.g., email, desktop alert) documented beyond Slack replies-on-completion, and no evidence of a unified notification system across all interfaces. Missing for 10: explicit 'agent needs input' alerting outside Slack/CLI, native desktop/mobile push notifications, and independent confirmation these notifications work reliably in practice.
